summary: Fable-directed plan to make MP connection bulletproof: map every entry-path failure mode, then Fable 5 designs the aggressive auto-attach + reconnect architecture and an executable test matrix

maps.entryFlow: Owner path (1): a website battle-call is meant to deep-link BOTH peers into one server-minted room — caller to ?mproom=<rid>&mprole=host, callee to ?mproom=<rid>&mprole=guest. Game side: caller boot sets _qmBootRoom + nulls _pendingRoomJoin (multiplayer.js:300-304), auto-opens MP (7805), and on lobby SUBSCRIBED runs _qmHostFallback → _pendJoin(rid,{role:'host'}) → openRoomWithId + advertiseRoom (772, 3704-3712, 3788-3800). Callee boot sets _pendingRoomJoin (286), auto-opens MP (7796), SUBSCRIBED runs _pendJoin(rid,{role:'guest'}) (762-766); the guest fast-paths on the host's lobby room-meta (onRoomMeta:4546) or, after ~10s, joinRoomDirect + a 45s _hostEvidence watchdog (4156-4241). Convergence = both on rr-lobby with the SAME rid, host emitting room-meta, guest reading host evidence over realtime (softPresence broadcast; native presence never syncs).

failureModes.scenario: THE SITE GAP: the website only navigates the CALLEE into ?mproom=&mprole=guest and never opens the CALLER as host. The caller never boots ?mprole=host, so _qmBootRoom is never set, _qmHostFallback never runs, and no host room is ever opened. rr_active_rooms shows only the callee. The lone guest runs its full _pendJoin, the roomStatus preflight returns alive:false (or never answers), and the callee dead-cards on 'THAT ROOM IS CLOSED' / 'ROOM DIDN'T ANSWER'.
failureModes.cause: Site (Lovable) edge/navbar emits only the guest URL; the game's host-side boot fallback (multiplayer.js:296-304 → _qmHostFallback:3704) has no trigger. The game cannot self-heal because the caller's tab never loads with the pairing.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:300-304 (host boot-fallback) + SITE battle-call accept/navigation (Lovable, not in repo)

failureModes.scenario: BOTH-AS-GUEST / NO HOST: if the site sends both peers mprole=guest (or omits mprole, which defaults both to the guest pend), nobody opens the room as host. Both guests joinRoomDirect and synthesize room.id off the rid, but _hostEvidence() never becomes true (no host in room.members, no matchCh, no host room-meta), so both hit the 45s 'NO HOST IN THIS ROOM' fail card. Two guests in a channel is never a playable 1v1.
failureModes.cause: mprole defaults to guest when absent/!=host (multiplayer.js:302-304); _hostEvidence requires real host proof (4165-4173); no election promotes a guest to host in a battle room.

failureModes.scenario: CALLEE-ARRIVES-FIRST / one-shot preflight ejects a merely-slow host: the guest's roomStatus preflight fires ONCE at tick===2 (~5s). If the host is still booting (1800ms open delay + lobby subscribe + game.js decode) and hasn't registered the room server-side yet, roomStatus returns alive:false → _roomDead latches true → guest is ejected with 'THAT ROOM IS CLOSED' even though the host is a few seconds behind. There is no re-check after tick 2.
failureModes.cause: Single-shot preflight + permanent _roomDead latch (multiplayer.js:4200-4217); the host's openRoomWithId never POSTs a room-create, so server aliveness lags realtime and depends entirely on the site row.

failureModes.scenario: HOST NEVER REGISTERS THE ROOM SERVER-SIDE: openRoomWithId only broadcasts realtime room-meta and mints a join-by-code; it never creates an rr_active_rooms row. So the guest's roomStatus preflight and any server-side reconnect reflect only whatever the SITE registered — the exact 'rr_active_rooms empty' symptom — and a host that opens purely from the deep-link is invisible to every server-authoritative check.
failureModes.cause: No room-create REST call in the host open path (multiplayer.js:3788-3800); convergence rides realtime broadcast only, which the preflight (a REST check) can contradict.

failureModes.scenario: STALE / MISMATCHED RID: host opens under _qmBootRoom (the caller URL's rid) while the guest pends its own URL's rid. If the site mints two different rids, reuses a stale rid from a prior call, or the two URLs disagree, the channels never intersect — host sits in an empty room, guest 45s-fails. No cross-check that the two rids match.
failureModes.cause: Each side trusts its own URL rid (multiplayer.js:286, 300-304); no server confirmation the pairing rid is shared/live.

failureModes.scenario: NO RECONNECT FOR A BATTLE ROOM: only rr_tour and rr_showroom are persisted for boot-time revival (7807-7811); there is NO rr_room key. If either peer's tab reloads or the engine reload drops the ?mproom query (mid-match crash, blur/refresh after navigation), there is no auto-rejoin to the battle room. Battle rooms are private, so they are also not findable via Browse. This directly violates the owner's 'EASY intelligent reconnect to that room' mandate.
failureModes.cause: No sessionStorage persistence of the active normal room + private rooms excluded from the directory (multiplayer.js:7807-7811, 4552).

failureModes.scenario: PRESENCE NON-CONVERGENCE after direct-join: once the guest joinRoomDirects, _hostEvidence depends on the host's room-meta (lobby) or host heartbeat landing in room.members over softPresence broadcast. If the host's lobby channel is mid-resubscribe (CHANNEL_ERROR/TIMED_OUT at 773) when the guest pings, no re-advertise fires, room.members[p1] stays empty, and the guest 45s-fails despite a live host.
failureModes.cause: room-ping re-advertise is best-effort and only fires if the host's lobbyCh is currently SUBSCRIBED (multiplayer.js:737, 4186); softPresence heartbeat is the only 'who's here' signal and can miss a reconnecting peer.

failureModes.scenario: HOST-SLOW-BEYOND-45s loop: maxTries=18 (~45s). A cold-cache host (large game.js decode, video backdrop) can exceed 45s to open, so the guest fail-cards; TRY AGAIN re-pends but the host may STILL be booting, producing a loop of fail cards instead of convergence.
failureModes.cause: Fixed 45s guest patience with no adaptive backoff or server-confirmed 'host is coming' signal (multiplayer.js:4158, 4218-4238).

failureModes.scenario: HOST _openHost silently no-ops if already engaged: _pendJoin's host branch bails when room.id||tour.id||matchLive is set (4136). A leftover show room, a boot-revived tour (rr_tour), or a stale room means the paired battle room never opens — with NO fail card — and the guest strands.
failureModes.cause: Guarded open with no fallback/close-and-retry when the host is already in another context (multiplayer.js:4132-4143); reconnect revival (7807-7810) can win the boot race and occupy the host.

failureModes.scenario: _qmBootRoom LEAKS under ?mpqm=resume + 'waiting': if the accept URL carries ?mpqm=resume alongside the pairing, the SUBSCRIBED handler runs qmResume (not the _qmBootRoom else-branch, 771). If matchStatus returns 'waiting', qmResume sets the searching state and returns WITHOUT consuming _qmBootRoom, so the pre-minted host room is never opened and the guest strands.
failureModes.cause: qmResume's 'waiting' branch has no _qmHostFallback call before returning (multiplayer.js:3724-3730); the _qmBootRoom consumer is only the else-branch at 772.

failureModes.scenario: REALTIME DOWN = bare banner, no rope: if the guest's lobby subscribe never reaches SUBSCRIBED (Realtime/anon auth failure), _pendingRoomJoin is never consumed; the player sees only a grey 'Could not reach the live lobby' banner and no fail card / retry rope. The battle call silently evaporates.
failureModes.cause: Deep-link consumption lives entirely inside the SUBSCRIBED branch (multiplayer.js:762-772); the error branch only schedules a resub + banner (773-776).

failureModes.scenario: HOST-SIDE DEAD-END (no re-ring): after the host opens the paired room, if the guest never boots/declines, the host sits at 'waiting for 1 player' with no timeout, no NO-ANSWER escalation, and no automatic re-call — contrary to the 'aggressively rope two people in' mandate.
failureModes.cause: openRoomWithId → enterRoomWaiting has no host-side inbound-call watchdog for the auto-battle path (multiplayer.js:3798, 4490-4492).

gaps: Owner mandate 'receiving a call SHOVES you directly into a host room' is unmet: the SITE never opens the caller as host, so the game's host boot-fallback (_qmBootRoom → _qmHostFallback) has no trigger. FIX = site emits the caller ?mproom=<rid>&mprole=host into the SAME rid it created and registers server-side; game side is already wired.

Owner mandate 'EASY intelligent RECONNECT to that room' is unmet for battle rooms: no rr_room persistence + private rooms absent from Browse means a reloaded/dropped peer cannot get back in. FIX = persist an rr_room descriptor (rid+role) like rr_tour/rr_showroom and revive it in the boot chain (7807-7811); optionally re-pend from a server /room-status.

No server-authoritative room registration on the host open path: openRoomWithId never creates an rr_active_rooms row, so roomStatus preflight and any server reconnect see only site state (the 'rr_active_rooms empty' symptom). FIX = host POSTs a room-create/heartbeat so aliveness is truthful.

One-shot roomStatus preflight + permanent _roomDead latch ejects a merely-slow/late-booting host (callee-arrives-first). FIX = re-preflight (or trust realtime host-evidence over a single REST alive:false) before hard-ejecting.

No rid-agreement guarantee between the two URLs and no host-side re-ring when the guest is absent — both weaken the 'aggressive + intelligent roping' mandate. FIX = server confirms a shared live pairing rid; host re-emits the call on a timeout.
maps.reconnectStory: Today's reconnect for a battle-call room is effectively ABSENT. Boot-time revival only covers rr_tour (bracket) and rr_showroom (show), never a normal/battle room (multiplayer.js:7807-7811; only 5692/5997 persist). The sole 'reconnect' is that if the tab reloads with the ?mproom query still intact, the deep-link re-pends — but a mid-match engine reload or any in-app navigation drops that query, and battle rooms are private so they never appear in Browse to rejoin manually. In-flight resilience exists ONLY within a single page life: _pendJoin re-pings + retries for 45s, onRoomMeta heals a direct-joined guest's p1/flags (4534-4544), room-gone triggers _roomGoneRescue (4079-4089), and the guest watchdog ejects from a dead/host-never-came room with a TRY-AGAIN card (4218-4238). Once the page reloads without the query, all of that is gone — no rid is remembered, so neither peer can be shoved back into the room. This is the concrete gap against the owner's 'EASY, intelligent reconnect' requirement.

maps.path: Reconnection / room-rejoin after reload or dropped connection — normal 1v1 "Battle Room" path (the target of all 4 MP entry paths: auto-battle-call, host-panel launch, browse rooms, People→Challenge)
maps.entryFlow: All four entry paths converge on the SAME normal (non-show) room object + `rr-room-<rid>` channel. Auto-battle-call: callee is SHOVED in via `_pendJoin` (deep-link `?mproom=&mprole=guest` at :286/:3141) while the caller opens the paired room via `_qmBootRoom`→`_qmHostFallback()` (:772/:3704/:7805). Host-panel "Play in Reactive Rhythm": `?mproom=<rid>` → `_pendingRoomJoin` → `_pendJoin` (:285/:7796). Browse rooms: `joinRoom(rid)` off `roomsDir` meta (:4247). People→Challenge: `_pendJoin(rid,{notificationId})` (:3090). `_pendJoin` is the unified funnel (:4121): meta fast-path → tick-4 `joinRoomDirect` late-host fallback → tick-2 `roomStatus` preflight → 45s fail card. Once seated, the host authors a versioned `room-state` beat every 4s (:464) that `onRoomState` (:474) converges guests from.
maps.reconnectStory: Reconnect today is strong for LIVE-CHANNEL FLAPS (socket drops with the tab still alive) and NON-EXISTENT for RELOADS of a normal room. Flap handling: `joinRoomChannel`'s subscribe callback catches CHANNEL_ERROR/TIMED_OUT/CLOSED → `_scheduleChannelResub('room')` (:3934) rebuilds the room channel with bounded exponential backoff (≤20 tries, 2s→15s, :3288) while module-level `room`/`sel`/`meReady` survive; `_roomResubActive` guards the counter (:3312); on SUBSCRIBED it re-asserts READY (:3315) and flushes the MP-5 crit-queue. Mid-MATCH flaps: `_rebuildMatchChannel` (:3363, MP FIX #21) reopens the read side WITHOUT teardownMatch, `_oppGoneGrace` (:2374) suppresses a false forfeit for a my-side blip, and the crit-queue re-sends my FINAL on reconnect. The connection chip (`_paintConnChip` :3262) surfaces LIVE/RECONNECTING/OFFLINE and is tap-to-retry (`_connRetry` :3321, wired :7350). `onRoomState` (:474) is a versioned self-healing snapshot that re-converges an EXISTING guest's setup state. RELOAD recovery, however, exists ONLY for SHOW rooms (`rr_showroom`/`maybeReconnectShowRoom` :5689/:5702, host-only) and tournaments (`rr_tour`/`maybeReconnectTour` :5993/:6002, both roles). A normal 1v1 battle room has ZERO sessionStorage persistence and ZERO boot-revive.

failureModes.scenario: Host of a normal 1v1 battle room reloads or crashes the tab (any of the 4 entry paths — created via lobby, auto-call caller, challenge acceptor-as-host). On reload the room is permanently dead; the guest is stranded and neither peer can get back to the room.
failureModes.cause: No persistence for normal rooms. `persistShowRoom` is guarded `room.show && room.isHost` (:5691) so it never fires for a battle room; the boot-revive only checks `rr_tour`/`rr_showroom` (:7807-7810). A created room's rid is never written to the URL (no replaceState; `?mproom=` is only ever READ at :286), so a host with no URL param has no handle to revive. `beforeunload` even broadcasts `room-gone` (:7769), actively killing the guest's session. There is no host-migration for 1v1 (that exists only for tournaments, `maybePromoteHost` :6018).
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:5691 (persistShowRoom guard), :7807-7810 (boot revive omits normal rooms), :7769 (beforeunload room-gone), :6018 (host-migration is tour-only)

failureModes.scenario: Either peer reloads or crashes MID-MATCH in a normal 1v1. The live run is lost for both; there is no rejoin into the in-progress match and no persisted match pointer.
failureModes.cause: `matchId`/`matchCh`/`matchLive`/`sel` are module vars with no sessionStorage mirror; nothing persists a normal match. The surviving peer's `_oppGoneGrace` (:2374) expires → `oppLeft=true` forfeit (:2388) and the 8s settle-safety hollow-forfeits. The reloaded peer boots with no match memory and no `?mproom` (URL never carries the match/room), so no boot path re-enters. Contrast tournaments, which persist the live snapshot (`persistTour` :5993) and rejoin in place.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:2374-2388 (opp-gone→forfeit), :2116 (matchLive is a bare module flag), :5993 (tour persists but 1v1 does not), :7807-7810 (no match/room boot-revive)

failureModes.scenario: Guest who joined a battle room via BROWSE ROOMS or People→Challenge (no `?mproom=` in their URL) reloads. They cannot get back into the room even though it is still live and the host is present — they land on the plain lobby with no memory they were ever in a room.
failureModes.cause: Reload recovery for a guest depends entirely on the boot-time `?mproom=` param (:286→`_pendingRoomJoin`→:7796). `joinRoom`/`_pendJoin` never push the rid into the URL (no history.replaceState anywhere) and never write a `rr_room` sessionStorage key. So the only battle-room joiners who survive a reload are those who arrived via a deep-link that is still in the address bar; browse/challenge joiners have nothing. No 'you were in a room' memory, no REJOIN pill — the exact affordances the mandate calls for.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:4247 (joinRoom — no persist/URL write), :4121 (_pendJoin — no persist), :286 (mproom read-only at boot), :7796

failureModes.scenario: A normal room's connection exhausts the 20-attempt resub cap and goes 'dead' (conn chip → OFFLINE, tap-to-retry) WHILE a match is live. On the #game screen the retry affordance is invisible, so the player cannot recover without knowing to navigate back to the MP screen.
failureModes.cause: `_scheduleChannelResub` gives up loud at `_connResubN>=20` → `_setConnState('...','dead')` (:3294). The only recovery UI is the conn chip/mini, but both live inside `#multiplayer-screen` (index.html:6118 `#mpx-conn-chip`, :6505 `#mpx-conn-mini`) — during a live run the active screen is `#game`, so neither is on-screen. There is no in-#game reconnect pill, so a dead socket mid-match is a silent dead end for the user.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:3294 (dead after 20), :3321 (_connRetry only via chip), index.html:6118/6505 (chip lives on MP screen, not #game)

failureModes.scenario: Deep-link guest (auto-battle-call / host-panel invite) reloads while the HOST is ALSO gone (both reload, or host closed the room). The guest re-pends but is dead-ended with a fail card rather than reconnected — there is no revive of the room the way a show room self-heals.
failureModes.cause: On reload the guest's `?mproom=` re-drives `_pendJoin` (:7796), but `_pendJoin` only JOINS an existing host channel — after the tick-4 `joinRoomDirect` synthesizes a channel with no host evidence, the tick-2 `roomStatus` preflight (:4200) or the 45s `_hostEvidence` timeout (:4225) fires the 'NO HOST IN THIS ROOM' / 'ROOM DIDN'T ANSWER' card. Because a normal room is never host-persisted/revived (unlike `maybeReconnectShowRoom` which re-advertises the channel :5720), there is no path for the room itself to come back.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:4225-4238 (no-host fail card), :4200 (roomStatus preflight), :5720 (show room self-revives; no normal-room equivalent)

failureModes.scenario: Any battle-room participant reloads after the rid handle was stripped from the URL (e.g. site nav that drops `?mproom=&skipIntro=1`, or the game normalizing its own URL). The single reconnect handle is gone, so even a still-live host+room become unreachable.
failureModes.cause: The rid lives ONLY in the transient `?mproom=` query param; nothing mirrors it to sessionStorage or re-writes it back into the URL after consumption (`_pendingRoomJoin` is nulled once consumed, :4149/:4192/:4221). The invite URL is built on demand (`roomInviteLink` :4308) but the live URL is never kept in sync, so a reload after any URL change has no rid to recover from.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:4308 (invite link built, never persisted to location), :4149/:4192/:4221 (_pendingRoomJoin nulled after use), :286 (single source is the boot query param)

gaps: No sessionStorage persistence for a normal 1v1 battle room (neither host nor guest). `rr_showroom` is show-host-only and `rr_tour` is tournament-only; there is no `rr_room` key and no `maybeReconnectRoom()` boot path (:5691, :7807-7810). This is the root gap behind the mandate's 'auto-rejoin on reload' + 'persistent you-were-in-a-room memory'.

No host-side revive of a battle room on host reload, and no 1v1 host migration. `maybeReconnectShowRoom` re-advertises the show channel (:5720) and `maybePromoteHost` migrates a tournament host (:6018), but a normal 1v1 has neither — a host reload permanently kills the room for both peers.

No mid-match reconnect for a RELOAD (only for a socket flap). `_rebuildMatchChannel` (:3363) recovers an in-tab blip, but a reloaded peer has no persisted `matchId`/`sel` and no boot path, so a normal 1v1 in progress is unrecoverable — unlike tournaments which persist the live snapshot (:5993).

No REJOIN pill / one-tap rejoin surfaced anywhere. The only rejoin affordance is the conn chip's tap-to-retry (`_connRetry` :3321), which (a) only re-subscribes an already-open channel — it cannot reconstruct a room after reload — and (b) is not present on the #game screen during a live run (index.html:6118/6505).

The reconnect handle is fragile: the rid exists only in the boot-time `?mproom=` query param; it is never written to sessionStorage nor kept in the live URL (no history.replaceState). Browse-joined and challenge-joined guests have NO handle at all, and deep-link guests lose it if the URL changes (:286, :4308).

`beforeunload` actively broadcasts `room-gone` for a host (:7769) with no grace/persist, so even a fast reload tells the guest the room is dead rather than holding the seat for a returning host — the opposite of the mandate's 'hold the room for a returning peer'.

Guest-reload recovery, where it works at all, is a fresh JOIN (`_pendJoin`) that dead-ends on a fail card if the host isn't present (:4225-4238) — there is no 'the room is holding your seat, rejoining…' state and no auto-retry loop that survives a temporarily-absent host beyond the flat 45s window.

maps.path: People → Challenge → live 1v1 (lobby-presence roster CHALLENGE button → sendChallenge handshake → rr-match-<mid>)
maps.entryFlow: Lobby-presence roster (`mpx-roster`, populated from `lobby[]` softPresence broadcast-heartbeats via onLobbySync/renderRoster, multiplayer.js:781-848) renders a per-peer CHALLENGE button wired to sendChallenge (:844). sendChallenge (:851) mints a mid, sets pendingOut + a 24s _chalGrace (:854-856), broadcasts `challenge` on rr-lobby targeted by toId, re-emits ≤4×/2s (_chalRetry :868-873), and arms a 12s no-response timeout (_chalT :861). Target's onChallenge (:876) sets incoming[fromId]={mid} → roster row flips to ACCEPT/✕ (:829-830). acceptChallenge (:881) broadcasts `challenge-ans{ok:true}`, clears incoming, and opens rr-match-<mid> as GUEST via startMatchChannel (:886), re-emitting the ans ≤6×/2s until oppPresent (_ansRetry :892-896). Challenger's onChallengeAns (:903) opens the SAME rr-match-<mid> as HOST (:918). Both converge in enterSetup (first match SUBSCRIBED, :3349); host picks track + both READY → maybeStart broadcasts `start` (+re-emits, :1404-1415) → beginMatch (:2102). Convergence key = the shared mid on rr-match; presence via softPresence hb heartbeats (:312-356).
maps.reconnectStory: For this path reconnect is CHANNEL-level only. A transient socket blip on rr-match-<mid> is rebuilt in place: _onMatchSubStatus's error branch calls _scheduleChannelResub('match')→_rebuildMatchChannel (bounded backoff ≤20, matchId preserved, :3354-3369); on re-SUBSCRIBED it re-asserts READY and (host) re-delivers the locked song so a mid-setup blip can't deadlock (:3350-3353). Packet-loss resilience: challenger's 24s _chalGrace honors a late accept even after the 12s timeout nulled pendingOut (:910); guest's _ansRetry (:892-896) and host-side start re-emits (:1412-1415) each tolerate a single dropped broadcast; the A6 both-ready watchdog re-fires the emitter at T+6s and loud-fails with a READY-again failcard at T+14s (:3492-3516). CRITICAL LIMIT: a pure challenge duel has NO room and NO server record — matchId/pendingOut/incoming live only in memory. A full backToLobby, page reload, or a peer that truly leaves has no 'rejoin this duel' affordance; the mandate's 'easy reconnect to that room' cannot apply because there is no room to reconnect to (unlike the ONLINE-NOW roster's battleCall path, which opens a real room).

failureModes.scenario: Accept broadcast never reaches the challenger (dropped or challenger stalled) → guest stranded alone on rr-match while the challenger never opens the host side.
failureModes.cause: Guest re-emit budget is shorter than the rescue window it is meant to fill: _ansRetry stops at ~12s (`++_rt > 6`, 6×2s) while the challenger's _chalGrace advertises 24s. Between 12-24s no ans is being sent, so a challenger whose stall clears late (or drops onChallengeAns entirely) never opens rr-match-<mid>; the guest sits on the match channel with only an escalating 'Waiting for your opponent to join…' line and NO teardown/auto-return.
failureModes.codeRef: multiplayer.js:892-896 (_ansRetry cap) vs :856/:910 (_chalGrace 24s); no stranded-guest match-channel timeout

failureModes.scenario: Presence never converges on rr-match → READY button stays disabled forever, silent start deadlock with no failcard.
failureModes.cause: A roomless challenge duel gates READY purely on oppPresent (refreshReadyEnabled: roomStage=false so oppHere=oppPresent, :1183; ok requires oppHere, :1192). softPresence beats only every 10s after the initial hb (:342), so a single dropped heartbeat once both are already SUBSCRIBED delays convergence up to 10s, and a persistent drop deadlocks it. Because neither can set meReady, the A6 both-ready watchdog never arms (requires meReady&&peerReady, :3494) → no COULDN'T-SYNC failcard ever fires; only the escalating wait line shows.

failureModes.scenario: Both players challenge each other near-simultaneously and both click ACCEPT → two guests on two different match channels, no host, deadlock.
failureModes.cause: renderRoster shows incoming (ACCEPT) with precedence over pendingOut/WAITING (:829-834), so each sees the other's ACCEPT. Each acceptChallenge opens rr-match-<other's mid> as GUEST (:886); the reciprocal challenge-ans is discarded because its mid matches neither pendingOut.mid nor _chalGrace.mid (:909-911). Result: A is guest on mid_B, B is guest on mid_A — no host on either channel, permanent deadlock.

failureModes.scenario: 12s no-response timeout fires before a legitimately slow accept, dropping the duel.
failureModes.cause: _chalT nulls pendingOut and shows 'No response' at 12s (:861). Under a background-tab-clamped target, or a dropped initial 'challenge' that only _chalRetry re-delivers at ~8s (:870) followed by human reaction, the accept commonly lands >12s. _chalGrace (:910) is supposed to rescue this to 24s, but per failure #1 the guest stops re-emitting its ans at 12s, so the 12-24s grace window is effectively unbacked.

failureModes.scenario: Challenging someone who just entered a match (stale inMatch flag) → dead challenge, 12s 'No response'.
failureModes.cause: sendChallenge and the row-disable both key on lobby[toId].inMatch (:852,:834), but inMatch rides presence meta refreshed only every ~10s (softPresence beat :342, myPresence(matchLive||matchCh)). In that window the target is on the match screen; onChallenge sets incoming (:876-879) but they never see the ACCEPT (not on the lobby roster) → challenger eats the 12s timeout.

failureModes.scenario: Challenging a ghost peer that crashed/closed without a 'bye' → 12s wait on nothing.
failureModes.cause: softPresence holds a peer for 75s after its last heartbeat (:345); a hard-closed tab lingers in the roster. onLobbySync only clears the dead pendingOut once the ghost finally expires from lobby[] (:785), so the challenger sits on WAITING… until the 12s _chalT fires 'No response'.

failureModes.scenario: Guest's rr-match SUBSCRIBE errors/timeouts → guest never reaches setup and is left on the lobby while the challenger waits as host.
failureModes.cause: enterSetup runs only on the FIRST match SUBSCRIBED (_matchSubbedOnce, :3349). If the guest's channel subscribe hits CHANNEL_ERROR/TIMED_OUT, it never enters setup; it has already broadcast its accept, so the challenger opens the host side and waits on an escalating line. The guest gets only a bounded resub (≤20) then a dead-conn chip — no auto-return to lobby, no failcard.

failureModes.scenario: Phantom ACCEPT re-appears for a duel the guest is already in.
failureModes.cause: acceptChallenge clears incoming={} and opens the match (:885-886), but the challenger's _chalRetry keeps re-emitting 'challenge' for up to ~8s (:868-873). A re-received challenge re-sets incoming[fromId]={mid} (:876-879); if the guest backs out to the lobby it sees a stale ACCEPT for the match it already joined (idempotent but confusing).

gaps: No room = weakest reconnect of the four mandated paths. A pure sendChallenge duel has no room/server record — recovery is limited to in-memory bounded channel-resub of rr-match-<mid> (_scheduleChannelResub/_rebuildMatchChannel :3354-3369). A full leave, backToLobby, or page reload has NO 'rejoin this duel' affordance; the mandate's 'easy, intelligent reconnect to that room' is structurally unmet because no room exists.

Two different buttons are both labeled CHALLENGE: the lobby-PRESENCE roster (mpx-roster) → sendChallenge (this path, roomless); the ONLINE-NOW roster (mpx-online, :2918-2933) → battleCall (site path, opens a real room). The path that satisfies the reconnect mandate is battleCall, NOT this one — so 'People → Challenge' is ambiguous and the reconnect-capable variant is not the presence-roster CHALLENGE.

Window mismatch: challenger _chalGrace = 24s (:856) but guest _ansRetry only re-emits for ~12s (:894 `++_rt > 6`). The rescue window the challenger honors is not backed by the guest's re-emit budget, so late-accept rescue silently fails past 12s.

No stranded-participant timeout on the challenge match channel: if the handshake half-completes (one side on rr-match, the other never joins), BOTH sides wait indefinitely (host and guest each on an escalating 'waiting' line) with no auto-forfeit, no 'opponent never joined — back to lobby' failcard, and no re-challenge shortcut.

READY is gated purely on presence convergence with a 10s heartbeat and no fallback (:1183/1192/342) — a single dropped hb stalls the start up to 10s, and a persistent drop deadlocks it silently because the both-ready watchdog can't arm without meReady (:3494).

onChallenge lacks a p.fromId!==ME.id guard (:876-877); only the roster's ME.id row-filter (:810) prevents a self-challenge today — defense-in-depth gap if any reflected/duplicated challenge carried fromId===ME.id.

maps.entryFlow: Two "seat a 2nd player" paths. (A) BROWSE ROOMS: a host opens a public room via openRoom→openRoomWithId (multiplayer.js:3780/3788), which one-shot-broadcasts room-meta via advertiseRoom (3802) into every peer's roomsDir (4217/4553). Other players discover it in the lobby LIVE NOW list (renderLiveNow, 4595) or the Browse screen (renderRooms, 4719) and click JOIN → joinRoom(rid,false) (4247) → joinRoomChannel → onRoomPeers seats the first non-spec joiner as p2 host-side (3977-3982); host START→startRoomMatch→room-start hands both seats into the match channel. (B) HOST-PANEL "PLAY IN REACTIVE RHYTHM": the site opens /game?review=<token>; catalog.js resolves it → #review-launch card (catalog.js:3025+); the host presses PLAY (solo launchTrack) or GO LIVE → RhythmMP.openShowRoom (catalog.js:3199 → multiplayer.js:4912) → a PUBLIC room.show=true room where the host runs and everyone else WATCHES; a 2nd player only arrives via the artist call-in (/show/invite, catalog.js:3236) or a host-opened challenger seat.

maps.reconnectStory: Transient socket flaps are covered: room channel resub with bounded ≤20 backoff preserving `room` state (_scheduleChannelResub('room'), 3934/3308), mid-match "Reconnecting…" banner (3359), room-start re-emit + both-ready watchdog, _critQ re-flush on SUBSCRIBED (3918), _pendJoin re-pings a late host ~45s (4156-4194), and _roomGoneRescue on positive room-gone proof (4079). But PAGE-LEVEL reconnect exists ONLY for show rooms and tournaments: rr_showroom persist + maybeReconnectShowRoom (5689/5702/7810) and rr_tour. There is NO rr_room persistence for a normal 1v1 room — neither host nor guest. A normal-room host who refreshes/crashes vanishes with no rejoin (guest then hits the "host never showed" fail card, 4236); a guest who refreshes has no way back except an ?mproom deep-link they usually don't have. There is also no in-UI "reconnect to the room you dropped from" affordance for normal rooms — the mandate's "easy, intelligent reconnect" is only realized for show/tournament, not for the core browse/battle 1v1.

No loser-of-race resolution: concurrent JOINs resolve only host-side with no explicit 'seat taken → spectate?' path for the client that lost, risking a ghost 'you are p2' state.

design.architecture:
DIRECTOR'S THESIS: today MP has four doors but only one hallway that actually holds weight (show rooms/tournaments). Everything else rides one-shot broadcasts and a query param that evaporates on reload. The fix is not more patches — it is ONE FUNNEL, THREE HANDLES, A SERVER OF RECORD, AND A VISIBLE ROPE.

1) ONE FUNNEL — every entry path ends in a normal ROOM, converged by _pendJoin. Auto-battle-call, host-panel launch, and Browse already do; People→Challenge (the roomless rr-match duel) gets converted: on acceptChallenge the CHALLENGER opens a private room (openRoomWithId with a minted rid) and broadcasts `challenge-room{mid,rid}`; the acceptor _pendJoin(rid,{role:'guest'}). This is deliberate unification: the duel inherits the room's entire reconnect machinery (resub, room-state beat, rr_room persistence below) instead of maintaining a parallel, weaker rr-match-only handshake. Mutual-challenge deadlock is killed with a deterministic tie-break: if incoming[fromId] exists AND pendingOut targets fromId, the LOWER ME.id becomes the room opener and the other side's outgoing is auto-cancelled.

2) THREE HANDLES — the room id must survive anything short of clearing the browser. (a) sessionStorage `rr_room` = {rid, role, name, sel, matchId, fromCall, ts} written on EVERY seat event: openRoomWithId (host), joinRoom/_pendJoin success (guest), updated at beginMatch, TTL 120s refreshed by the existing 4s room-state beat; cleared ONLY on explicit leave/room-gone-confirmed. (b) URL: history.replaceState writes ?mproom=<rid>&mprole=<role> into the live URL on seat and strips it on clean leave — this makes a reload of a Browse- or Challenge-joined guest identical to a deep-link boot, with zero new boot code. (c) Server row (below). Boot chain (multiplayer.js:7807-7811) gains `maybeReconnectRoom()` after rr_tour/rr_showroom: revive host → re-open rr-room-<rid>, advertiseRoom, re-emit room-state (guests re-converge via the existing onRoomState versioned snapshot at :474); revive guest → _pendJoin(rid,{role:'guest'}) which already self-heals via onRoomMeta.

3) SERVER OF RECORD — openRoomWithId (multiplayer.js:3788) currently never registers the room, so roomStatus preflight reflects only what the SITE wrote (the proven 'rr_active_rooms EMPTY' symptom). Game adds three tiny REST calls through catalog.js: room-create on open, room-heartbeat every 20s while room.id is set (piggyback the room-state beat), room-close on clean leave. Guest preflight (:4200-4217) becomes a RETRYING check (ticks 2/6/10) that NEVER hard-latches _roomDead off a single alive:false — realtime host-evidence (:4165) always overrides REST, and a server row with recent host_seen_at extends the 45s guest patience ("host is coming") instead of fail-carding a slow-booting host. FAIL-OPEN: if the edge function 404s (the known Lovable says-Ships-but-prod-404s gotcha), preflight is treated as unknown, never as dead.

4) THE HOST NEVER SILENTLY KILLS THE ROOM — beforeunload (:7768) stops broadcasting room-gone when rr_room persistence is armed; it broadcasts `room-brb{rid,holdMs:90000}` instead. The guest enters a HOLDING state ("Opponent reconnecting — seat held") with the seat reserved for 90s; host reload revives via maybeReconnectRoom and re-advertises, guest re-converges without ever seeing a dead card. Only an explicit LEAVE or a 90s expiry produces room-gone semantics. Host-side busy guard (_openHost bail at :4132-4143) stops being a silent no-op: if _qmBootRoom's rid differs from the current context and matchLive is false, close the stale context and open the paired room; if matchLive, show a "finish or forfeit to answer the call" card. qmResume's 'waiting' branch (:3724-3730) calls _qmHostFallback() before returning so ?mpqm=resume can never eat the pairing.

5) THE VISIBLE ROPE — a REJOIN pill: whenever rr_room exists and we are not currently seated in that rid, paint a crimson "REJOIN MATCH" pill on the start screen, jukebox header, and MP lobby; one tap = _pendJoin(rid,{role}). The connection chip (currently trapped on #multiplayer-screen, index.html:6118/6505) gets a mini clone inside #game HUD so a dead socket mid-match (resub cap at :3294) is tap-to-retry where the player actually is.

6) NO LOBBY LIMBO — battle-sourced rooms (fromCall/challenge flag in rr_room) honor the playtest-3 decree: each-readies-auto-start. When both seats are filled, both clients auto-focus READY; when both ready, maybeStart fires without the host pressing START. The callee is SHOVED: deep-link boot already auto-opens MP (:7796/:7805) — we add skipIntro handling so no menu is ever seen between click and seat.

7) DISCOVERY THAT CAN'T GO STALE — waiting rooms re-advertise every 10s (startLiveAdvertise loses its matchLive-only guard, :3831); joinLobby's SUBSCRIBED branch always sends a room-ping (not only when a deep-link pends, :743-777); renderRooms/renderLiveNow drop the pre-build173 'FULL=disabled' rendering (:4741/:4760/:4595) — JOIN is always clickable, the host is seat-authoritative, and a seat-race loser receives an explicit host `seat-denied` broadcast → "Seat taken — WATCH instead?" card. GO LIVE (openShowRoom) defaults openSeat to 'auto' so the host-panel launch surfaces a real challenger seat in LIVE NOW instead of a solo broadcast.

WHAT THE SITE (LOVABLE) MUST DO — three things, all mandatory: (S1) THE P0: on battle-call accept, navigate BOTH peers — callee to /game?mproom=<rid>&mprole=guest&skipIntro=1 (already done) AND the CALLER to /game?mproom=<rid>&mprole=host&skipIntro=1 with the SAME server-minted rid; if the caller is already inside the game, deliver the rid over the existing bc:user:<id> broadcast as {type:'call-accepted', rid} so multiplayer.js opens the host room in place with no navigation. (S2) register the rid in rr_active_rooms at call-creation time and expose room-create / room-heartbeat / room-status / room-close on the game-catalog edge function (anon-key writable for these four ops, rid-scoped) — and EXPLICITLY DEPLOY the function (known gotcha: agent says Ships while prod 404s; verify with a curl before declaring done). (S3) never strip the ?mproom query when routing /game, and keep the caller/callee rids provably identical (one mint, two URLs).

fixes.problem: No persistence for normal 1v1 rooms: rr_showroom is show-host-only, rr_tour is tournament-only. Any reload by either peer permanently orphans the room; Browse/Challenge joiners have no handle at all. Owner's 'easy intelligent reconnect' mandate is structurally unmet.
fixes.fix: Add rr_room sessionStorage descriptor {rid, role, name, sel, matchId, fromCall, ts} written on every seat (host open + guest join), refreshed by the 4s room-state beat, cleared only on explicit leave/confirmed room-gone. Add maybeReconnectRoom() to the boot revive chain after rr_tour/rr_showroom: host revives by re-opening rr-room-<rid> + advertiseRoom + room-state re-emit; guest revives via _pendJoin(rid,{role:'guest'}). Also history.replaceState ?mproom=<rid>&mprole=<role> into the live URL on seat (strip on clean leave) so reload==deep-link for all joiners.

fixes.problem: beforeunload broadcasts room-gone on host reload, actively telling the guest the room is dead even when the host is coming right back — the opposite of 'hold the room for a returning peer'.
fixes.fix: When rr_room persistence is armed, beforeunload sends room-brb{rid,holdMs:90000} instead of room-gone. Guest enters a HOLDING state ('Opponent reconnecting — seat held', countdown) instead of the dead card; seat reserved 90s; host revival re-advertises and the guest re-converges via onRoomMeta/onRoomState. Explicit LEAVE still sends room-gone immediately.

If the server row exists with recent host_seen_at, extend patience beyond 45s with a 'host is joining…' line. Fail-OPEN when the endpoint 404s/errors (treat as unknown, not dead).

design.selfCritique: Where my own design can still strand two players, in descending order of worry. (1) sessionStorage is PER-TAB: rr_room survives a reload but NOT 'user closed the tab and opened a new one' — the most common civilian recovery move. The URL handle only helps if they reopen via history. Mirroring to localStorage fixes that but invites cross-tab poison (two tabs fighting over one seat, stale rooms resurrecting days later); if we add it, it needs a strict TTL and a tab-ownership nonce, which I have not specced — this is the biggest residual hole against the owner's reconnect mandate. (2) The server of record is only as real as Lovable's deploy discipline: the documented failure mode is the agent declaring 'Ships' while prod 404s. I made the game fail-OPEN on preflight errors, which protects joins but silently degrades reconnect back to today's realtime-only behavior — the system can pass every game-side test while the server leg is secretly dead. The curl-verify step is procedural, not enforced. (3) F7 (challenge→room unification) rips out the most battle-scarred handshake in the file; memory shows challenge-reliability fixes were HELD across builds 145/154/155, meaning this exact area has a history of regressions and reverts. Unification is right long-term but it converts a working-if-fragile path into new code — it must ship behind its own build flag with the old rr-match path revivable. (4) room-brb honesty tax: a host who leaves for good now costs the guest a 90s hold before the truth arrives; combined with auto-start (F8) a returning-then-instantly-ready flow could shove an AFK guest into a countdown they didn't see. (5) The mutual-challenge tie-break assumes both peers see both challenges; if one 'challenge' broadcast is lost, the tie-break degenerates to the old race — the deterministic rule reduces but does not eliminate the double-accept window. (6) beforeunload is not guaranteed to fire (crash, OOM, mobile page freeze), so the guest's HOLDING state must also arm off heartbeat silence, which I implied but did not spec — without it a hard-crashed host still yields the old strand until the 75s presence expiry. (7) The harness itself lies a little: background-tab throttling on desktop Chromium is not mobile page-freezing; T17 passing does not prove a phone that fully suspends the page will hold its seat — that only T19 (two real devices) can prove. (8) Finally, the URL handle (?mproom in the live location) can collide with the site's own /game routing and the review-token param; F14 covers it, but any future site-side router change silently severs the third handle, and the game has no self-check that its URL survived — worth adding a boot telemetry event when a seat exists with no URL handle.
